Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q2 2020 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of COST.
We are reaffirming our full-year guidance and raising our EPS outlook to $2.07 per share.
We believe the pipeline is strong, but conversion timing remains uncertain given customer budget cycles.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q2 2020.
Our cloud segment grew 17% year-over-year, driven by strong enterprise demand.
Our outlook assumes current foreign exchange rates hold; currency fluctuations could materially affect results.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
What assumptions underpin your free cash flow guidance given the elevated capex spend?
Thank you for the question. We delivered record revenue of $27.7 billion this quarter, representing 17% year-over-year growth.
Second question - Analyst:
Can you clarify whether the margin expansion is sustainable into next year given rising input costs?
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 199 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
